material.description: OpenStax Introduction to Computer Science, §5.1 “Computer Systems Organization” (https://openstax.org/books/introduction-computer-science/pages/5-1-computer-systems-organization): the “Data Storage Inside a Computer” passage explains that conventional electronic computers store programs and corresponding data as sequences of bits/bytes. This supports digital representation and processing in the stated computing-system context; it does not generalize to every emerging or non-classical computing model.
